canDoYue: 你識用一分鐘講零售經驗、對客例子同自己嘅強項。
canDoEn: Give a one-minute retail intro with a past example and one strength.

dialogue.speaker: hugh
dialogue.text: Please tell me a little about the role you are looking for, and what you are doing currently?
dialogue.glossYue: 請講下你想做嘅職位，同埋你而家做緊咩？
dialogue.say: Please tell me a little about the role you are looking for, and what you are doing currently?

dialogue.speaker: zuri
dialogue.text: I have three years of retail experience behind me, and I am bilingual in both Cantonese and English.
dialogue.glossYue: 我有三年零售經驗，又識廣東話同英文。
dialogue.say: I have three years of retail experience behind me, and I am bilingual in both Cantonese and English.

dialogue.speaker: hugh
dialogue.text: Could you please give one clear example of a recent customer-facing task you enjoyed at the counter?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以講一個你喺櫃檯對客做過嘅例子？
dialogue.say: Could you please give one clear example of a recent customer-facing task you enjoyed at the counter?

dialogue.speaker: zuri
dialogue.text: Last year I handled a busy Saturday at the counter, because I achieved a calm queue before lunch.
dialogue.glossYue: 舊年我喺櫃檯頂過一個忙嘅星期六，開飯之前將條隊處理到好定。
dialogue.say: Last year I handled a busy Saturday at the counter, because I achieved a calm queue before lunch.

dialogue.speaker: hugh
dialogue.text: That story sounds reliable. How did teamwork help you in the shop on that busy morning?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個故事好可靠。嗰朝早團隊合作點幫到你？
dialogue.say: That story sounds reliable. How did teamwork help you in the shop on that busy morning?

dialogue.speaker: zuri
dialogue.text: Real teamwork helped me stay calm on that busy morning, and I kept the whole queue moving with the team.
dialogue.glossYue: 嗰朝真係靠團隊，我先至保持冷靜，同隊友一齊疏導條隊。
dialogue.say: Real teamwork helped me stay calm on that busy morning, and I kept the whole queue moving with the team.

dialogue.speaker: hugh
dialogue.text: What kind of team would you like to join next month if we offer you the retail role here?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我哋請你做零售，你想加入邊種團隊？
dialogue.say: What kind of team would you like to join next month if we offer you the retail role here?

dialogue.speaker: zuri
dialogue.text: I would like to join a small shop team, because I can start on a morning shift next month.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想加入一個細舖團隊，因為我下個月可以上早更。
dialogue.say: I would like to join a small shop team, because I can start on a morning shift next month.
